field.label: Client
field.help: The client this mapping applies to: a client name (wildcards * and [0-9] supported), an IP address, an FQDN, or a CIDR subnet. Use "default" for clients that match no other entry.

field.label: List groups
field.help: Comma separated list group names applied to this client. These must match the group values on the deny and allow lists under Filter Lists. Use "default" for the group applied to clients with no explicit mapping.
